entry.title: New: Resolution 376 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO MALAMA O PUNA TO ASSIST WITH FUNDING YOUTH ENGAGEMENT EVENTS FOR KEA‘AU MIDDLE SCHOOL IN THE 2023-2024 SCHOOL YEAR

Transfers $1,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)
